betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Boilers are only the start — this mod both makes and spends enormous amounts of steam: the §6Large Geothermal Steam Boiler§r burns magma around the clock; the §6Large Solar Overpressure Array§r moves the boiler room into the sky and lives on the weather; and the §6Gear Steam Compressor§r — note, it does not make steam — takes plain steam, pays a cost, and yields theoretically less superheated.

Each well has a temperament: geothermal wants magma plumbing, solar runs full by day and zero by night, the compressor is an on-demand stopgap.

From this chapter on, steam ledgers count in thousands of liters, and reservoirs are planned like seas.

§3Sun by day, magma by night, compressor whenever superheated runs short.§r
